title: B002: Implement Kubernetes-interacting packages
summary: Review #2 following external review feedback from gndrmnn. All 5 external review items were properly addressed in commit 3fdcc2a: ConfigMap creation switched to create-first approach, GetTLSSecret returns raw bytes instead of *Secret, EnsureDatabaseUser split into ensureUser/ensureGrant helpers with per-database privilege scoping, EnsureService rejects ClusterIP changes with an error, Makefile test-integration target implemented. Implementation covers 7 K8s-interacting packages (config/, secrets/, database/, deployment/, job/, tls/, policy/) with envtest integration tests, doc.go files, and reference documentation. go vet passes. Unit tests pass. One golangci-lint staticcheck finding (ST1005) in deployment.go:60.

architecture_findings.description: deployment/ and job/ packages use Get+Create/Update with optimistic concurrency instead of server-side apply with field manager as originally specified in task 3.4. The implemented approach is functionally correct for single-owner resources. Function signatures accept pre-constructed objects rather than variadic ownerRefs, which is a cleaner API for typed resources. Unchanged from review #1 — this is a deliberate design choice, not a regression.
architecture_findings.fix: No action needed. If SSA is later required for multi-controller conflict resolution, refactor to use client.Apply.

issues_found.description: golangci-lint staticcheck ST1005: error string should not be capitalized. The error message starts with 'Service' which violates Go convention for error strings (should be lowercase).
issues_found.fix: Change the error string to start with a lowercase letter: fmt.Errorf("service %s/%s ClusterIP cannot be changed: existing=%q, requested=%q", ...)

issues_found.description: AlreadyExists swallow style inconsistency. ensureUser (line 169-173) and ensureGrant (line 215-219) use inverted check '!apierrors.IsAlreadyExists(err)' inside an 'err != nil' block. Every other create-once function uses the canonical positive-check form: 'if apierrors.IsAlreadyExists(err) { return nil }'. The documented pattern in .planwerk/patterns/idempotent-create-with-alreadyexists-swallow.md specifies the positive-check form.
Magic numbers backoffLimit=4 and ttl=300 in RunDBSyncJob are unexplained local variables. Should be package-level named constants for clarity.

GVK declaration style inconsistency: database/ and tls/ extract GVKs to package-level vars, but secrets/ declares them inline within function bodies. Package-level GVK vars serve as self-documenting constants and make version bumps a single-line change.
issues_found.fix: Extract to package-level vars: var externalSecretGVK = schema.GroupVersionKind{...} and var pushSecretGVK = schema.GroupVersionKind{...}

issues_found.description: Missing test for IsExternalSecretReady when the ExternalSecret CR exists but has no Ready=True condition (exists-but-not-ready scenario). Only 'ready after SimulateExternalSecretSync' and 'not found' are tested.
issues_found.fix: Add TestIsExternalSecretReady_NotReady: create an ExternalSecret CR without calling SimulateExternalSecretSync, then assert IsExternalSecretReady returns (false, nil).

issues_found.description: Missing TestEnsureService_SetsOwnerReferences test. EnsureDeployment has an owner reference test (TestEnsureDeployment_SetsOwnerReferences at line 163) but EnsureService has none, leaving REQ-009 partially uncovered for this function.
issues_found.fix: Add TestEnsureService_SetsOwnerReferences following the same pattern as TestEnsureDeployment_SetsOwnerReferences.

suggested_improvements: Standardize t.Cleanup usage across integration tests — currently only config/ and policy/ use it while the other 5 packages do not. Both approaches are valid since envtest tears down, but consistency is preferred.
Consider extracting the repeated setMariaDBRef helper in database.go (3 occurrences of the same 5-line pattern) if the file grows further.

detected_patterns.name: Unstructured client for third-party CRDs, typed client for core resources
detected_patterns.applies_when: Creating or reading Kubernetes resources where no typed Go client exists (MariaDB, ESO, cert-manager CRDs)
detected_patterns.description: Third-party CRDs (MariaDB Database/User/Grant, ExternalSecret, PushSecret, Certificate) are managed via unstructured.Unstructured objects with explicit GVK, SetNestedField, and NestedSlice operations. Core K8s resources (ConfigMap, Secret, Deployment, Service, Job, CronJob) use typed clients from k8s.io/api. This avoids importing typed client libraries for operators that are not under our control.

detected_patterns.name: Idempotent create with AlreadyExists swallow (create-once resources)
detected_patterns.applies_when: Creating Kubernetes resources that should be created once and not updated (unstructured CRDs, immutable ConfigMaps, Jobs)
detected_patterns.description: For resources that are created once and not updated (CRDs managed by external operators, immutable ConfigMaps, Jobs), the canonical pattern is: attempt Create, if apierrors.IsAlreadyExists(err) return nil. For resources that need updates (Deployment, Service, CronJob), the pattern is Get+Create/Update with ResourceVersion preservation for optimistic concurrency.

detected_patterns.name: Get-then-Create-or-Update with ResourceVersion preservation (mutable resources)
detected_patterns.applies_when: Ensuring Kubernetes resources that may need updates on reconciliation (Deployments, Services, CronJobs)
detected_patterns.description: For resources that need updates when reconciled, the pattern is: Get the existing resource; if NotFound, Create; otherwise, copy ResourceVersion from existing to desired for optimistic concurrency, then Update. EnsureService additionally preserves the immutable ClusterIP field and rejects conflicting ClusterIP changes.

detected_patterns.name: Integration test structure with TestMain and envtest
detected_patterns.applies_when: Writing integration tests for any package that interacts with the Kubernetes API
detected_patterns.description: Each package's integration test file follows: //go:build integration tag, package_test package, var k8sClient client.Client, const testNamespace, TestMain that calls testenvtest.SetupEnvTest(), creates a dedicated namespace, runs tests, and calls teardown. Individual tests use unique resource names. Unit tests for pure functions use //go:build !integration tag and table-driven patterns.

detected_patterns.name: Simulator pattern for envtest CRD controllers
detected_patterns.applies_when: Adding a new simulator for a third-party CRD operator (e.g. cert-manager, ESO, MariaDB)
detected_patterns.description: Each simulator is a single exported function in its own file that calls the shared simulateUnstructuredReady helper with the appropriate GVK, condition reason, and message. The helper uses createOrGet for idempotency, then patches status via client.MergeFrom with status.ready=true and a Ready condition. For CRDs needing custom status (like ExternalSecret which creates a target Secret), a dedicated implementation is used instead of the shared helper.

detected_patterns.name: Error wrapping with operation context
detected_patterns.applies_when: Returning errors from K8s API calls or field manipulation
detected_patterns.description: All errors are wrapped with fmt.Errorf using %w and include: the operation being performed (verb-ing), the resource namespace/name, and the original error. Pattern for API calls: fmt.Errorf("<verb>ing <Resource> %s/%s: %w", namespace, name, err). Pattern for field operations: fmt.Errorf("setting <Resource> <field.path>: %w", err).

examples.code: return false, fmt.Errorf("getting ExternalSecret %s/%s: %w", namespace, name, err)

detected_patterns.name: Content-hash naming for immutable resources
detected_patterns.applies_when: Creating ConfigMaps whose content must trigger rolling restarts when changed
detected_patterns.description: ConfigMaps are named {base}-{hash[:8]} where hash is SHA-256 of sorted key=value pairs. This ensures: (1) identical content produces identical names (idempotent), (2) different content produces different names (triggers rolling restart via pod template annotation), (3) old ConfigMaps are preserved until garbage-collected via owner references.

detected_patterns.name: Create-first approach for content-addressed resources
detected_patterns.applies_when: Creating resources whose name is derived from content (e.g. hash-suffixed ConfigMaps)
detected_patterns.description: Attempt Create first; only on AlreadyExists do a Get to return the existing resource. This avoids a redundant lookup in the common case where the resource does not yet exist. Implemented per external reviewer (gndrmnn) feedback.
